query: SELECT COUNT(*) as matched FROM cobranca_planilha cp INNER JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON UPPER(TRIM(ar.cliente)) = UPPER(TRIM(cp.empresa)) AND LEFT(ar.vencimentoData, 10) = cp.vencimento AND CAST(ar.valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(18,2)) = cp.valor WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO';
